name: Kuk'tar
description: Kuk'tar was the second planet in the Kothlis system. It was a chaotic inhospitable world. Kuk'tar was a tiny planetoid with irregular orbit that teared the planet's surface to shreds. The proximity of the planet to its sun caused seering temperatures.
